findings: Exit ties at the same availability go through _select_cell and do not become a number. Same-version resume is a retry. A different calculation version is CALCULATION_REVISION and does not reuse the old summary as RETRY_SAME_BYTES.

The owner path records SIMPLE_SCREEN then COMPOUND_SCREEN in one journal. ESTIMATED_NET_PROXY is on the freeze critic packet and on CAP-HFIC-TEMPORAL-FIXED-TIME-PROXY-001. PRICE_RELATIVE_PROXY stays distinct from NetReturn.

What can pass a helper test and still distort a conclusion: assess_tier_progress will believe a caller-supplied list. The CLI readout tier_progress is taken from stored looks, so a compound tier is executed only when a look was saved. Exit conflict is not a raw return. Assumption cost is labeled and is not NetReturn.
discovery-execute shows search_tier and tier_progress. An unused compound tier is not marked executed. Preview does not include a target. Proxies are not labeled NetReturn.
